summary: Cover unit (封面) semantic judgments for 湖南农业大学 全日制普通本科生毕业论文(设计) cover template. Sixteen source entries processed in document order: the 附件1 封面基本格式 preamble and inline parenthetical style/format notes are cleanup (template-format obligations not to enter the clean template); the university name, document type, location 湖南·长沙, and the five basic-information labels (学生姓名, 学号, 年级专业及班级, 指导老师及职称, 学院) with their leading □ spacing and the ：separator are fixed_label; the Chinese title placeholder (毕业论文（设计）中文题目), English title placeholder (TITLE OF GRADUATION PAPER), student name (×××), student ID (20××××××××××), composite grade-major-class (20××级×××（×）班), advisor name (×××), advisor title (□教授), department (××××学院), and submission date (20××年××月) are fill_slots bound to fields from the pre-input vocabulary: thesis.title.zh, thesis.title.en, author.name.zh, author.student_id, author.cohort_class, advisor.name.zh, advisor.title, author.department, submission.date. All bindings were verified against field usage_affordance.allowed_part_roles (each selected field permits fill_slot). No body_structure or generated_content parts appear in the cover; cover is a fillable terminal keep rather than a generated area. No needs_input was triggered.
